pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal regions with rounded vertices. Edge transitions exhibit smooth pixel gradients likely due to focal blur. Patch size is largest on the anterior flank and shoulder, decreasing in spatial area towards the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes typically consist of tri-radiate or quadri-radiate intersections. Corridor thickness is consistent across the mid-flank but diminishes in the posterior-ventral quadrant.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck line. Individual hair tufts create a jagged silhouette against the low-contrast background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic avian organisms (oxpeckers); one positioned on the superior rump/tail-base area and another on the ventral abdominal line near the posterior leg.
